info.name: CoyoteGO Associated Entities API Shipper - Shipment APIs API

items.docs:
Allows Shippers to submit load build requests with relevant load information, including a Spot Quote ID. \
*Note: Including a Spot Quote ID is currently unsupported in Europe.*
Allows Shippers to retrieve the current load build status for a previously submitted request.
Allows Shippers to cancel a load that was previously submitted.

Based on a given search term, Coyote will return a list of all loads that match on any of the below reference number types associated to your loads.
```
ReferenceNumberType: 
    - "PRONumber"
    - "DeliveryNumber"
    - "AppointmentConfirmation"
    - "ProofOfDelivery"
    - "Reference"
    - "PoNumber"
    - "OrderNumber"
    - "CommercialInvoice" 
    - "ShipmentNumber" 
    - "MasterBillOfLading" 
    - "BillOfLading" 
    - "PickupNumber"
```
